source_quotes: we shouldn't just be reviewing dead code without identifying if it was superseded if not leave for review
identifying all superseded and status of all and any dead code not superseded we capture for review
overlap_check: method_24 (30024) reconciles incremental layers by removing the superseded original; this adds the cite-or-leave-for-review rule and the capture list. 30024 could be extended instead; kept separate because its trigger is adding a layer, not removing dead code.

payload.name: Remove Only What Is Shown To Be Superseded
payload.description: Code, rules or records are removed only when what replaced them is identified and cited. Anything that cannot be shown superseded is left in place and listed for review.

principles.name: A removal needs a successor
principles.description: Without one, 'dead' is a guess and the thing may be docs-registered, public or load bearing.

heuristics.condition: an item is public or documented in a registry
heuristics.action: treat it as live until the registry entry is also superseded

heuristics.condition: old and new versions of the same logic sit side by side
heuristics.action: apply the incremental layering reconciliation: remove the superseded original with its citation

decision_rules.name: Name the superseder
decision_rules.condition: an item looks dead, stale or replaced
decision_rules.outcome: identify the item that replaced it (symbol, commit, status section or ruling) and cite it in the removal note

decision_rules.name: Leave the rest for review
decision_rules.outcome: do not remove it; list it with file and line and why it looks dead

decision_rules.name: Capture what was superseded
decision_rules.outcome: record it in the checklist and the status document with its successor, so the supersession list stays complete

decision_rules.name: Check references first
decision_rules.outcome: search code, documents, registries and data for references and update or confirm there are none
